referenceDevice: BPI-R4 (MediaTek MT7988A/Filogic 880), combined EthWAN + EasyMesh Controller/Agent build
measurementCondition: 10-second aggregate /proc/stat sample (idle-delta method); all 4 cores online at 1800 MHz, governor=performance; traffic condition and connected-client count not recorded. Not a controlled workload test.
notes: Only aggregate CPU utilization was measured (5.56% averaged over 10 seconds, load average 0.18/0.65/0.42); no per-process CPU time or percentage breakdown was captured in this pass — the memory-footprint companion file has real per-process data, this file does not yet. Aggregate 5.56% on 4 cores corresponds to roughly 22% of a single core if normalized, but this is an interpretation of the snapshot, not a per-process allocation. See Hardware Compatibility Specification Section 5.1.1; per-process CPU profiling remains an open item (Section 7).
